facts.label: Contar e comparar
facts.sub: Use verbo + -ed ou o passado irregular para contar. Use funnier than e louder than para comparar.

facts.label: Passado
facts.sub: Para contar o que aconteceu, use o passado simples: I watched it. A cat jumped into a box. Para perguntas, use did + verbo base: Did you see it? Where did you find it?

facts.label: Comparar
facts.sub: Para comparar, use -er + than: louder than, funnier than. Com y no fim, vira -ier: funny vira funnier. Diga The baby was louder than the cat.

compare.br: No Brasil, dizemos “foi mais engraçado que o outro”.

compare.us: Em inglês: It was funnier than the first one. No passado, use was, ou verbo + -ed: watched, laughed.

items.s: We use did + base verb in past questions.

items.why: We say Did you see it?

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: We use did + base verb in past questions. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say “Did you saw it?”. → Falso (We say Did you see it?)
Funnier than means more funny. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: A busy cafe · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Monday morning in a busy cafe in Dublin. Rain falls on the old street outside. Vince sits with a cup of hot tea. His friend Sara comes in with a big smile. She holds her phone in her hand. Vince asks about her smile.
“Sara, did you see the funny video last night?” says Vince. “Yes! I watched it twice. It was funnier than the first one.” says Sara. “Where did you find it?” says Vince.
